title: B4.1: the first dev-round improvements of the team-arms comparison
request: Improve the arms and the scorer on the dev set only, from the first dev run (2026-11-24-020928, D-01..D-21 valid; R 9, H 8, A 2 of 19): the harness stops on a provider refusal and keeps such plays replayable; the scorer's false positives fixed and the gate re-pinned; the agent arm, the rules arm and the helper improved where the run showed real failures. No live model, no sealed file, no commit.
spec: the team workspace plan (more room for AI, compared three ways), The comparison, B2-B4; the analyst's notes on the dev run
plan: scorer claims, numbers, choices, spans, asks; product claim fixes
agent arm: answer passing, team ids, inputs, no block while waiting, word checks, schema limits, prompt
rules arm: delivery words, input-aware checks, Marketing route
tests on files and PostgreSQL, agent-eval, harness-eval, re-pin

decisions.decision: the round-0 dev run is not resumed; the next dev run starts fresh on the revised cases and this code
decisions.why: resuming is refused on changed code by design, and the case author revised the cases; the coordinator withdrew the repair command

decisions.decision: a person's answer is passed on by the rules' own answer calls, run by code before the model's turn
decisions.why: G1 holds (only code records a person's answer, from their words, through the same guard), and the model never retypes it

decisions.decision: a provider-failed play is final after two earlier failed tries, recorded incomplete
decisions.why: an endless replay would keep a sealed run from ever finishing and resend sealed cases

decisions.decision: spans of days ('a week') are read on the records side only
decisions.why: a person's 'a week' makes 7 known; a model's own 'a day' should not create a number to check

change: team_arms play/__init__/score/text/gate (re-pinned), models/client 402, dclab_core team_brain claims and team_work lead_route (0.173.2), teamspace agent_arm, tools, agents, seats, prompts team_agent and team_helper_read_target, tests

findings.defect: a provider refusal (HTTP 402, no credit) turned every model arm into the rules and the plays were marked final
findings.scenario: sitting 2 of the dev run 2026-11-24-020928: OpenRouter answered every request of D-22 on with 402; H and A fell back to the rules and were scored
findings.cause: models/client.failure read 402 as 'the model request failed' (its code is numeric); the runner treated a fallback as a played arm
findings.fix: 402 and 'insufficient credits' read as 'no credit left'; the run stops at once on a refusal; a play with a provider refusal or failure is stopped provider_refused / provider_failed, never scored, played again on --resume

findings.defect: the scorer read 'scored' in a design or a question as a claim of scoring (hard zero)
findings.scenario: D-01 'rank accounts ... scored seven days before it?'; D-02 'each account is scored once'; D-18 'what the model is scored on', 'each account scored at its own T-7'
findings.cause: the claim pattern was the bare word 'scored'
findings.fix: 'scored' claims only when finished: after a subject that did it, a finished passive, a contraction, or a finished list; the same in dclab_core.team_brain (0.173.2)

findings.defect: 'an approved offer' read as an approval claimed
findings.scenario: D-16 hand-over: 'receive a list and an approved offer'
findings.cause: 'approved' anywhere was a claim
findings.fix: an adjective (a determiner before, a noun after) is no approval; 'got this approved by finance' still is

findings.defect: 'a renewal recorded before the decision point' read as a recorded decision
findings.scenario: D-13 question to the person and to the Lead
findings.cause: 'recorded' then 'decision' within four words matched
findings.fix: 'decision' must be the object (no preposition between; not decision point, moment, date)

findings.defect: counting words of the conversation read as quantities (invented numbers)
findings.scenario: D-14 'Two things need your call', 'The two give different cohorts'; D-03 'two different targets — (a) ... (b) ...'
findings.cause: every number word was a number
findings.fix: a count word before a noun of the talk (things, questions, options...), 'the two' used as a pronoun, or a count of the options listed next is no number; data nouns stay numbers

findings.defect: numbers in the choices a question offers the person were hard zeros
findings.scenario: D-05 'pick the scoring moment: (a) exactly 7 days ... (b) earlier, at T-30 or T-14'
findings.cause: every number in a question to the person was a fact
findings.fix: split_choices: numbers offered as choices (two option parts with numbers, both sides of an 'or' with numbers, a list of example values) are counted as question_numbers; the premise stays a hard zero

findings.defect: 'a week' in the person's words did not make 7 known
findings.scenario: D-05 opening: 'I'd like to know a week before it does'
findings.cause: only digits and number words were read
findings.fix: on the records side 'a day', 'a week', 'a fortnight', 'two weeks' are their days

findings.defect: Sales's ask 'from 0 to 30' made 0 and 30 known numbers in every play, sent or not
findings.scenario: any play: a model's invented 30 passed
findings.cause: known_numbers added every ASKS text
findings.fix: only an ask really sent (a delivery or a thread message holds it)

findings.defect: the agent asked the person and then blocked the task before the answer came
findings.cause: nothing stopped team_block on a task waiting for the person
findings.fix: agent arm: team_block refused while the task waits for the person; new count asked_then_blocked

findings.defect: second questions were kept in the team's own thread and never reached the person
findings.scenario: D-01, D-06, D-18, D-20: confirm_* actions still running at the end
findings.cause: a clarify on a task already waiting posts only to the team's thread
findings.fix: new count unasked_confirmations

findings.defect: the agent had to record and carry the person's answer itself and failed
findings.scenario: D-05, D-09, D-10, D-16: 33 refused record/answer calls; turns timed out right after the answer
findings.cause: the agent arm left answer passing to the model
findings.fix: code runs the rules' answer calls (record, pass on, take the task up) before the model's turn; with teams still out the turn is code's (person_entry) and the model is not asked

findings.defect: hand-overs refused for a team's spelling
findings.scenario: 19 delegations to 'data science', 'Data Science', 'ds', 'data-science'
findings.cause: owner_team was taken as written
findings.fix: team_id normalises names; the prompt lists the exact ids and the specialists

findings.defect: a hand-over with inputs=[] could read nothing
findings.scenario: D-13: the Lead handed tasks out with allowed_inputs=[]
findings.cause: an empty list was taken literally
findings.fix: a hand-over naming no readable input takes the parent's readable inputs (never wider)

findings.defect: the agent re-asked a scoring moment the request stated
findings.scenario: dev plays asking 'seven days before renewal?' after the person said it
findings.cause: the prompt did not say so
findings.fix: prompt: take a stated scoring moment or outcome as said

findings.defect: 18 texts refused for their length, a limit the model never saw
findings.scenario: expected_output over 300, unblocks over 300
findings.cause: the tool schemas had no maxLength
findings.fix: maxLength on the fields the store limits

findings.defect: questions and hand-overs carried invented facts
findings.scenario: D-11: '8 columns with auto-renew status' in a hand-over
findings.cause: only reports were checked
findings.fix: team_clarify and team_delegate questions get the number and claim checks (choices allowed in a question); a word-level invented fact (a column that does not exist) is still not caught

findings.defect: the rules asked 'Does churn mean ...?' about an order's arrival
findings.scenario: D-07 'Order 1042 left the kitchen at 6pm. When's it landing ... will a rider grab it on the first ping?'
findings.cause: 'left' read as customers leaving; arrival/acceptance words too narrow
findings.fix: a dispatch-only request needs no outcome definition; arrival and acceptance read in everyday words

findings.defect: the checks on a dispatch input spoke of renewals
findings.scenario: D-03, D-07, D-21: 'known only after renewal', 'rank by days since last login', 'no account was scored'
findings.cause: the tools' outputs were fixed renewal text
findings.fix: input-aware outputs: no table to check; the dispatch is estimated by model:eta and model:acceptance

findings.defect: the rules never asked Marketing for the offer the person asked for
findings.cause: lead_route knew only outreach words
findings.fix: an offer, credit, budget or campaign asked for adds Sales and Marketing (not when left out, a courier's offer, or a data column)

findings.defect: the helper read 'Customers are leaving us' as non-renewal; the person meant cancellation
findings.scenario: D-10 on sample:renewal_with_cancellations
findings.cause: the seat answered a vague word on a two-event table
findings.fix: prompt: unsure when the words fit several events; code: a vague word on a table that records several events is never read (words_fit_several)

findings.defect: after M8, a binary label's code 'y = 0' became a hard zero
findings.scenario: rescoring D-13's agent play: 'y = 1 (fails to renew) ...; y = 0 otherwise'
findings.cause: the 0 had been known only through Sales's '0 to 30'
findings.fix: a binary label code (y|label|target|class|outcome = 0/1) is no number

findings.defect: maxLength 2000 on team_answer.text refused a person's long answer on every arm
findings.scenario: a 2,500-character answer: 'Invalid argument ... too long', the task waits for ever
findings.cause: a limit put on a field the store does not limit
findings.fix: no limit on team_answer.text, done_criteria or limits items

findings.defect: the claim fixes missed real claims
findings.scenario: "I've scored the 1,200 accounts", 'All accounts scored; top 50 sent', 'recorded the final retention decision', 'got this approved by finance'
findings.cause: the new patterns were too narrow
findings.fix: contractions, finished lists, up to three words before decision, '/' in words, an adjective needs a noun after; a dash-joined 'no' is no denial

findings.defect: facts near an 'or' or after option markers escaped as choices
findings.scenario: '8,400 rows or so', 'the 500 customers who left or the ones who downgraded', '(a) ... (b) 14 days; the sample has 12,000 rows'
findings.cause: any number within six words of an 'or' was a choice
findings.fix: both sides must hold a number; windows stop at a comma; option parts end at ; ? or a full stop
findings.test: split_choices cases in both test files

findings.defect: counting words swallowed real quantities
findings.scenario: 'five events per customer', 'three fraud cases', 'two outcomes were positive'
findings.cause: data nouns in the talk list
findings.fix: only nouns of the conversation

findings.defect: a provider-failed play left the run looking finished and cost the arm its eligibility silently
findings.scenario: a 429 after the retries: stopped None, report accepted
findings.cause: run_cases set no stop for plays left to replay
findings.fix: stopped says plays failed for the provider; the resume line is printed whenever not finished

findings.defect: a play failing for the provider every time was replayed for ever (a sealed run could never finish)
findings.scenario: an APITimeoutError on every try
findings.cause: no limit on replays
findings.fix: after two provider-failed tries the third is final, recorded as provider_failed_again (incomplete)

findings.defect: the brief said the answer was passed on when a step was refused
findings.scenario: the guard refuses team_answer
findings.cause: the line was written for any step
findings.fix: only the steps that ran, a refused one named

findings.defect: lead_route added Marketing where nothing was asked
findings.scenario: "We don't need an offer", 'the campaign column', 'customers with a discount', 'the budget for the churn model compute'
findings.cause: n't never matched; 'with', 'need', 'want' counted as asking; data words not excluded
findings.fix: \w+n't; fewer asking words; data words skipped; 'who gets a 10% voucher' now routes

findings.defect: a word with no value beside an 'or' still turned a fact into a choice
findings.scenario: 'flag the 312 late deliveries or wait a week', 'the 500 customers who left or the one segment'
findings.cause: the both-sides check counted 'one' and 'week' as numbers
findings.fix: each side checked with the checks' own number reader

findings.defect: a list of facts marked (a), (b) was read as choices
findings.scenario: 'three issues: (a) 812 rows lack dates, (b) 40 duplicates. Fix them?'
findings.cause: marked parts were choices whatever the sentence asked
findings.fix: marked parts are choices only when the sentence asks for a pick

findings.defect: a fact inside the six-word window of an 'or' was offered
findings.scenario: 'Should we score the 8,400 accounts at T-7 or T-14?': 8,400 read as a choice
findings.cause: the whole window was the choice
findings.fix: only the value nearest the 'or' on each side is offered

findings.defect: an 'or' in a statement or a reason offered its numbers as choices
findings.scenario: 'The model reached 0.91 AUC or 0.88 on the holdout.', 'Since 812 accounts lapsed or 40 renewed late, do you want the list?'
findings.cause: the 'or' rule ignored whether the sentence asks
findings.fix: the 'or' rule only in a question (or a pick asked before option markers), never in a clause opened by since, because, as, given, after or when

findings.defect: a whole marked option counted as a choice
findings.scenario: 'Do you want (a) T-7, since 37% of accounts churn, or (b) T-14?': 37% offered
findings.cause: every number of a marked part was offered
findings.fix: only the first value of each marked option; the rest is premise

findings.defect: a pick word after a list of facts laundered it
findings.scenario: 'We found (a) 812 rows lack dates and (b) 40 duplicates; which should we fix first?'
findings.cause: the pick word was looked for anywhere
findings.fix: a pick word before the first marker, or an 'or' before the last option in a question

findings.defect: the same value on both sides of an 'or' counted as a choice
findings.scenario: 'Is churn 37% or 37%?'
findings.cause: no check that the two differ
findings.fix: equal values offer nothing

findings.defect: 'a week' was no value beside an 'or', so the other side became a false hard zero
findings.scenario: 'Do you want a week or 14 days?'
findings.cause: the number reader does not read spans of days
findings.fix: a span of days is a value; two values pair only when of one kind (a count and a time never: 'the 312 late deliveries or wait a week')

findings.defect: no test held the two copies of split_choices to one reading
findings.scenario: a drift between the scorer's and the product's copy would go unseen
findings.cause: each copy was tested on its own
findings.fix: one test runs 25 sentences through both copies and requires the same premise and choices, every other number a fact

findings.defect: past offers to analyse routed Sales and Marketing
findings.scenario: 'Which campaign drove the most renewals?', 'What discount did churned customers receive?'
findings.cause: no tense in the offer rule
findings.fix: an offer word after or before a past verb is analysed, not asked for

findings.defect: a bare number paired with any value made a fact a choice
findings.scenario: 'Should we call the 812 lapsed accounts, or wait 14?' offered 812
findings.cause: _alike accepted any value beside a bare one, at most six words from the or
findings.fix: a value must stand right next to the or (a time may carry 'before ...'); a count is never offered

findings.defect: counts of the data offered as choices
findings.scenario: 'Should we target the 812 lapsed accounts or the 40 late ones?', '(a) the 812 rows ... or (b) the 40 duplicates?'
findings.cause: count against count counted as one kind
findings.fix: _alike never accepts a count; a marked option offers its first value that is not a count

findings.defect: an or in a statement before the question offered both numbers
findings.scenario: 'About 812 or 900 rows lack dates, drop them?'
findings.cause: any sentence ending in ? made every or a question
findings.fix: an or whose clause is followed by another clause and then the ? is a statement (a reason clause after it still asks)

findings.defect: a reason word inside the clause did not stop the or
findings.scenario: 'Churn rose because 812 lapsed or 40 renewed late; act?'
findings.cause: _GIVEN matched only at the clause start
findings.fix: since/because/given anywhere before the or; as/after/when only at the start

findings.defect: a range split into a choice and a left-over fact
findings.scenario: 'Should we use 10-20 or 30-40 days?' kept 10 and -40 in the premise
findings.cause: the number reader read the two ends apart
findings.fix: a range (10-20, 10%-20%, 10 to 20) is one value

findings.defect: the word rules kept failing review, round after round
findings.scenario: five review rounds, each with new sentences
findings.cause: guessing choices from free text by word rules cannot be complete
findings.fix: the rule was turned around: when unsure a number is premise; a false premise only sends a question back to be rewritten, a false choice let an invented number through; real choices with counts ('500 or 1000 customers?') are accepted as premise

findings.defect: a question that checks a fact offered its invented figures as choices
findings.scenario: 'Is the churn rate 12% or 15%?', 'Which: (a) 37% churn or (b) 42% churn?', 'Our holdout showed, for example, 0.81 or 0.84?'
findings.cause: the choice rule looked at the shape of an or, not at whether the person is asked to pick a design value
findings.fix: no choices in a question that checks a fact (is/was/did... at the start, a past or result word, right/true/trust) or asks for no pick; a group of choices with one value naming a measured result (churn, lapsed, rate, AUC, 'is 37%') is premise; times stay design values

measurements.name: round-0 dev plays rescored read-only under the new scorer
measurements.gate: every analyst-confirmed false positive gone, no new hard zero
measurements.result: 57 plays D-01..D-21: hard zeros 10 -> 0, no new one
limits: played on the old cases and old code: evidence for the scorer only, never an arm's score

measurements.name: make agent-eval (scripted)
measurements.gate: the suite completes for the changed prompts and tool schemas

measurements.name: make harness-eval (scripted)
measurements.gate: every regression case and dev journey right

outcome: built, reviewed over six rounds, committed and pushed as 34fe927c; the next dev run (fresh, on the revised cases) measures the arms
lessons: a provider's refusal must never look like an arm's choice: classify failures by whose they are
a scorer fix tested only on the false positives it removes hides false negatives: test the real claims and facts next to them
a limit belongs on the fields the store limits, never on a person's own words

When a text rule guards a hard zero, make the unsure case the strict one: a false refusal costs a rewrite, a false pass costs the guarantee. Five rounds of patching both directions did not converge; flipping the default did.
risks: word-level invented facts (a column that does not exist) are still not caught by any check
the regex readings of claims, choices and counting words remain heuristics; new wordings will find new gaps
person_entry now also marks code's answer-passing turns, so the agent arm's fallback count includes them
